# SHA-256 of every frozen contract file, re-derived on each CI platform
# before anything compiles. See .github/verify-candidate-digests.py.
#
# MEANING: "the frozen contract files are unchanged". Since SA-2B1a this no
# longer pins Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock or src/lib.rs, which runtime slices must
# edit; tests/dependency_provenance_v1.rs, pinned here together with its
# lock baseline, now guards every dependency instead. The SA-0 contract
# (source, specs, tests, fixtures) keeps its corrected-contract bytes, and
# the storage contract (spec/state-store-v1.md, its golden fixture) is
# frozen alongside it. It is not, and must never become, "whatever was
# committed last": a change to any listed file has to arrive with the reason
# it changed.
#
# SA-0D amended the SA-0 contract on purpose: it registers the pairing,
# grant-status and peer-error wire surfaces in spec/v1.md and adds `state`
# to PROTOCOL_FIELDS, so those five files carry new digests.
#
# SA-2B2a1 adds spec/pairing-v1.md, the pairing wire contract (Noise
# framing, pairing ID derivations, producer order, receiver client). No
# existing line changed.
#
# SA-0E amended the SA-0 contract on purpose: it registers the receiver
# peer store surfaces (peers.json) in spec/v1.md, adds `host`, `peers` and
# `port` to LOCAL_ONLY_FIELDS, and makes the registry test compare its
# field sets with the spec table rows. spec/v1.md, src/security.rs, the
# consent fixture, tests/security_contract_v1.rs and spec/security-v1.md
# (which pins that test module's hash) carry new digests.
#
# SA-2B2a2 adds spec/peer-store-v1.md, the receiver peer store contract
# (peers.json). spec/pairing-v1.md changed on purpose: the receiver claim
# now takes the Pair URL, and the attempt-record rule changed (a refusal
# sent before any commit removes the record its own connection created, a
# transport failure after the handshake ends the call, and a full record
# table no longer stops the client from connecting).
#
# SA-2B2a3 changed spec/pairing-v1.md on purpose: it adds the "Listener"
# section (bind re-validation, the 8-connection cap, per-connection
# identity, stop), and the low-order remote static non-claim became a
# rule: both handshake sides refuse an all-zero X25519 with the remote
# static.
#
# SA-2B2b1 adds spec/report-peer-v1.md, the producer side of the peer
# report path (static binding, refusal codes, limits, source seam, memory
# accounting, per-chunk authorization under the store turnstile).
# spec/pairing-v1.md changed on purpose: the Peer request key set now
# dispatches to the report path (F-10), the 4,096-byte cap applies to the
# three pairing surfaces only, and Listener::start takes the report state.
#
# SA-2B2b2 changed spec/report-peer-v1.md on purpose: it adds the
# "Receiver" section (fetch steps, error mapping, the shape gate, the
# measured decode reservation, receiver memory and non-claims) and the
# receiver acceptance map. spec/peer-store-v1.md changed on purpose: the
# grant guards (set_state and update_grant name the grantId, upsert refuses
# a lower authEpoch) and from_confirmed taking host and port from the grant.
#
# SA-0F amended the SA-0 contract on purpose: the control `status` success
# data may carry `null` for `bindHost` and `nodeLabel` (not configured yet),
# so a fresh install can answer `status`. spec/v1.md, src/security.rs,
# tests/security_contract_v1.rs and spec/security-v1.md carry new digests.
#
# SA-2B2c1 adds spec/control-v1.md, the local control wire contract (the
# control.sock admission rules and pathname exception, the handshake
# framing over the frozen control MACs, deadlines, the nine commands, the
# client). No existing line changed.
#
# SA-2B2c2 adds spec/runtime-v1.md, the runtime contract (assembly, the
# listener slot, stop order, the shutdown hook, the F-7 disable
# composition and the enable gate, the housekeeping schedule).
# spec/control-v1.md changed on purpose: listenConfigure calls the
# runtime's listen hook before its reply, the shutdown hook's effect is
# the runtime's, and status and pendingList leave out offers and pending
# records past expiresAt. spec/pairing-v1.md changed on purpose: the F-7
# disable-half non-claim now points at the runtime's entry points.
#
# SA-2B3a adds spec/cache-store-v1.md, the on-disk producer and receiver
# cache contract (flat pcache-/rcache- namespaces, file layout, caps and
# eviction, the three get reservations, failure semantics, non-claims).
# spec/state-store-v1.md changed on purpose: it describes the four cache
# primitives of the secure root (read_file_sized, list, remove_file,
# remove_stale_temps), lists the cache files in the root, and corrects the
# umask-evidence wording (storage doc todo d1-d2: the second CI run is now
# 43016382735 at fe1af3b, and the maintainer's Mac claim names the branch
# it takes and how that was observed).
#
# SA-2B3b changed spec/runtime-v1.md on purpose: the receiver pull entry
# point and its cache (Runtime::pull, Runtime::last_good, set_state before
# remove_peer on revoked or expired, the cache opened at start without
# retry), housekeeping's purge_expired and listener retry, the
# listenConfigure hook keeping a listener already on the stored address,
# the SA-2B3b acceptance map and three non-claims.
#
# SA-2B3cd adds spec/source-v1.md, the report source contract (engine pin
# and provenance exception, secure-root layout, owner inputs and the
# approved-scope record, report steps, D1 containment, non-claims), and
# the D1 fixtures tests/fixtures/v1/source/default-roots.json and
# environment-keys.json, and codex-duration-timing.jsonl (the engine's own
# Codex timing fixture, copied at the pin). tests/dependency_provenance_v1.rs changed on
# purpose: tokscale-core is the one git dependency allowed, pinned to a
# full SHA that the lock must repeat. The lock baseline fixture changed on
# purpose: it adds the 209 packages tokscale-core brings, four fields each.
